summary: Experienced mountaineer critically injured in a 200-foot tumbling fall on Little Pawnee Peak; evacuated from a dangerous gully with Flight For Life, Colorado Army National Guard, and Front Range Rescue Dogs; 30 members, about 4 hours
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group + mutual aid
notes: [Merged 2026-09-10: RMRG 2010 page confirms 30 RMR members, Flight For Life + Colorado Army National Guard + Front Range Rescue Dogs assistance, loose/dangerous gully high on the peak.] Boulder Weekly police blotter (parent-opened run 632): 200-ft rockslide fall 'Saturday' (2010-08-21) near Brainard Lakes in the Indian Peaks Wilderness Area; notes victim as an exceptionally experienced Seven Summits climber; agencies: Indian Peaks FD, RMRG, BCSO, Boulder County Emergency Services, CO National Guard, Red Cross. Corroboration merge. Merged 2026-09-15.
